name: pyautogui_screen_locate
description:
Find an image (needle) on the current screen and return its center coordinates.

Takes a fresh screenshot, then runs template matching (OpenCV) to locate the needle image. Returns `found: false` when confidence is below threshold.

`confidence` range: 0.0–1.0 (default 0.9). Lower for fuzzy matching.

image.description: Absolute path to the needle PNG image to find on screen
